app.name: LabConnect
app.footer: LabConnect · operated under QCI branding (interim). Endorsement wording to be confirmed.

home.title: Find an accredited lab for your test
home.intro: Search NABL-accredited testing laboratories by test, product, standard or lab. See prices and turnaround, and book a drop-off slot.
home.calibrationNote: Calibration labs are listed, but you can't book them on LabConnect yet.

search.textPlaceholder: For example: tensile strength, cement, IS 1608
search.locationDenied: Location is off for this site. Allow it in the browser to sort labs by distance.
search.pincodeSoon: Search by PIN code is coming soon. Use your location for now.
search.countDistance: {count} labs on this page · sorted by distance. LabConnect doesn't rank labs as "best".
search.countRelevance: {count} labs on this page. LabConnect doesn't rank labs as "best".
search.mapLabel: Map of the labs on this page
search.mapUnavailable: The map is not available in this browser. The list shows every lab.
search.listedNote: Prices and slots appear once the lab joins.
search.noResultsText: Try a wider radius or fewer filters, or ask us to bring a lab on board.
search.errorText: Something went wrong on our side. Your search is kept.

lab.verify: Verify on the accreditation body's website
lab.scopeSearchLabel: Search the accredited tests at this site
lab.priceListNote: Prices from published list v{version} · effective {date}
lab.gstNote: Prices exclude GST ({rate}%). The lab confirms the final price when it accepts your request.
lab.requirementsNone: The lab has not published sample requirements.
lab.noPin: The lab's location on the map is being checked.
lab.listedText: This lab is accredited but hasn't joined LabConnect yet, so prices, slots and online booking aren't available.
lab.calibrationText: LabConnect books testing only for now. You can see this lab's calibration scope, but you can't book it here yet.
lab.bookingSoon: Online booking opens in the next release. Prices and slots shown here are the lab's published ones.
lab.errorText: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again.

lead.introLab: {lab} is listed but can't take bookings yet. Tell us you need it and we'll contact the lab.
lead.titleNoResult: Ask us to find a lab
lead.introNoResult: Tell us what you need tested. We'll let you know when a lab can do it.
lead.whatHelp: Your search is filled in for you.
lead.emailHelp: We'll write when the lab joins. We don't share your email with the lab.
lead.sentText: We'll email you if the lab joins or we find another lab.
lead.errorEmail: Enter a full email address, like name@company.in.
lead.errorWhat: Tell us which test you need.
lead.failed: The request could not be sent. Please try again.
lead.rateLimited: Too many requests. Try again in a few minutes. Your text is kept.
lead.labNotFound: This lab can't be requested. Search again to find it.

auth.title: Sign in to LabConnect
auth.intro: Sign in to continue. You'll come back to the same page.
auth.emailHelp: We'll email you a 6-digit code. There is no password.
auth.codeSent: Code sent to {email}. It works for 10 minutes.
auth.codeInvalid: That code didn't match. Check the email and try again.
auth.codeExpired: This code has expired. Send a new one.
auth.locked: Sign-in for this email is paused until {time}.
auth.lockedNoTime: Sign-in for this email is paused for a while. Try again later.
auth.rateLimitedNoTime: Wait a few minutes before asking again.
auth.emailInvalid: Enter a full email address, like name@company.in.
auth.failed: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again.
auth.mfaIntro: Your role needs a second step. Enter the code from your authenticator app.
auth.mfaInvalid: That code didn't match. Check your phone's time is set automatically.
auth.mfaLocked: Try again at {time}. Lost your phone? Contact LabConnect support. They will check who you are before an administrator resets it.
auth.mfaLockedNoTime: Try again later. Lost your phone? Contact LabConnect support. They will check who you are before an administrator resets it.
auth.enrolText: Your role needs a second step and you haven't set one up yet. Setting it up on the web comes in the next release; ask LabConnect support in the meantime.
auth.sessionEnded: You were signed out after a period without activity. Sign in again to carry on.

signUp.title: Create your LabConnect account
signUp.emailIntro: Enter your work email. We'll email you a code. There is no password.
signUp.organisationHelp: Company, institution or government body; GSTIN on invoices
signUp.fullNameHelp: Used as the name on reports and invoices.
signUp.errorGstinLength: A GSTIN has 15 characters. This one has {count}.
signUp.errorGstinFormat: This isn't a valid GSTIN. Check it against your GST certificate.
signUp.errorGstinTaken: Another customer account already uses this GSTIN. Ask its administrator to invite you.
signUp.failed: Something went wrong on our side. Nothing was saved. Try again.
signUp.signedOut: Your session has ended. Sign in again to finish creating your account.
signUp.forbidden: This account can't create a customer organisation.
signUp.doneText: You can book a test now. Nothing to pay until a lab accepts.
signUp.alreadyTitle: You already have a customer account
signUp.alreadyText: You're signed in to {organisation}. Find a lab to book a test.
signUp.staffText: Platform staff accounts can't join a customer organisation.
